Curator publishing.

Publish mods to the live collection. Only someone with the private Netlify token can submit releases.

Getting startedOfficial modsLiveSplit setupTime WarpMod developmentUninstallingTroubleshooting
Uploads also need Netlify Blobs access. In Site configuration → General → Site details, copy the Site ID and add it as NETLIFY_SITE_ID in environment variables available to Functions. Create a Netlify personal access token in your user settings and add it as NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN, also available to Functions. Keep that account credential private and server-side. It is separate from the MOD_ADMIN_TOKEN curator secret below. Redeploy after adding the variables.

Curator setup

Where do I get the token?

You create it yourself. Netlify does not issue a curator token automatically. Generate a private random value, then save the same value in your Netlify site's environment variables as MOD_ADMIN_TOKEN.

  1. Generate a secret on your computer. Open PowerShell and run this once:
$bytes = New-Object byte[] 32
$rng = [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create()
$rng.GetBytes($bytes)
$token = [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes).TrimEnd('=').Replace('+','-').Replace('/','_')
Set-Clipboard -Value $token
$rng.Dispose()

This copies a fresh 256-bit secret to your clipboard. Keep it private; do not paste it into chat, source files, or a public issue.

  1. Save it in Netlify. Open your Netlify site → Site configuration → Environment variables. Add MOD_ADMIN_TOKEN, paste the clipboard value as its value, and make it available to Functions.
  2. Redeploy the site. The function reads the environment variable when running. Redeploy after adding or rotating the token.
  3. Paste the same token below when publishing. The page sends it to the API in an Authorization header and does not save it in browser storage.

Not deployed yet? The token field will not work on a local static preview. First deploy the project with Netlify CLI and configure MOD_ADMIN_TOKEN. If the token is lost or exposed, generate another and replace the Netlify value.

Access

Your token is required for every submission and is never stored by this page.

Use the value you generated and added in Netlify.

Mod details

Use a new version number for updates; the same mod ID and version cannot be published twice.
